text: M5.03 implementation is complete with deterministic independent R parity and JVM/JS gates: docs/verification/umvpa-group-summaries-20261007/README.md and execution.json. The consumer now exposes approximate population mean versus known-Gaussian common-effect scope, full original covariance/df, Q/I2/tau2 and empirical subject variance, plus separated held-out-subject/adaptation summaries. This is engineering evidence only; no Monte Carlo type-I/coverage qualification or independent review is asserted. Use the retained M5.02 adverse-baseline and M4.09 criteria; preserve approximate/unavailable labels and test fixed versus estimated uncertainty separately. New API includes typed refusal for partial native maps, unavailable prevalence and predictive population tests.
